desc: Implement the element-by-element bitmask DP solution in the provided starter code.
Precompute the LCM for every target subset mask, handling duplicate targets and using a large infinity cap if needed.
For each element in `nums`, compute the minimum increment cost for every non-empty target mask using `(-num) % lcm[mask]`.
Update the DP for each `nums` element by trying all subsets it can cover, including the option of skipping the element, while preventing the same element from being used more than once.
Run the implemented solution against the provided examples and edge cases, and report a SAMPLE TESTS verdict.
